title: Rainbow percolation
summary: We consider the weight-dependent random connection model on a Poisson point process of intensity $λ$ on $\mathbb{R}\times(0,1)$ in which the vertices $(x,t)$ and $(y,s)$ are joined precisely when $(t\vee s)|x-y|\leβ$. Points at distance $d$ are joined with probability $\min(1,β/d)^2$, the critical decay of one-dimensional long-range percolation, and edges sharing a vertex are dependent through the common mark.
